definitions.mentions: Recorded mentions across Wikipedia, Reddit, Bluesky, annotations, StackExchange and news. Other recorded mentions retain legacy totals without a platform breakdown. Wikipedia counts article–work matches, not repeated citations within one article.
definitions.reach: Countries and institutions identified in available citing-work affiliations; these counts do not measure readers.
definitions.coverage: Missing data or zero recorded mentions does not establish an absence of engagement. Wikipedia book-reference discovery is bounded and English-focused.
definitions.downloads: Full-text downloads via OAPEN (books) or DataCite (datasets/software). Closed-access, journal-only, or unmatched portfolios legitimately report zero — that is a coverage gap, not a usage signal.
